name: knowledgex
description: Long-term memory with judgment: Claude keeps what matters from your conversations, and nothing else.
long_description: KnowledgeX gives Claude a memory you can trust. At the end of a conversation, Claude suggests what is worth keeping, such as decisions and the reasons behind them, preferences, lessons, and people. It saves only what you approve. Notes are plain text files in a folder on your computer, so nothing is stored anywhere else. Each note shows whether you have confirmed it and when it goes out of date, and Claude says so when it uses one.

notes_folder.title: Notes folder
notes_folder.description: Where your notes are kept. Leave empty to use a KnowledgeX folder in your Documents. The folder is created if it doesn't exist. If you pick a folder that already has other files, notes go in a KnowledgeX folder inside it.

your_name.description: Recorded when you confirm a note is correct. Optional.
